name: convert_pem
title: Convert PEM (list and extract blocks, or wrap DER)

name: resolve_oid
title: Resolve OID (name, validate, list, encode, decode)

name: compute_fingerprint
title: Compute fingerprint (DER digest, key identifier, SHAKE256)

name: decode_asn1
title: Decode ASN.1 (node tree, typed read, re-encode)

name: encode_asn1
title: Encode ASN.1 (JSON node spec to DER)

name: inspect_certificate
title: Inspect certificate (RFC 5280 report, extensions, fingerprints, signature check)

name: create_certificate
title: Create certificate (CA or leaf, from a JSON spec, Web Crypto signed)

name: encode_x509_structure
title: Encode X.509 structure (one building block to DER, from a JSON spec)

name: decode_extension
title: Decode extension (one extnValue by OID, the 19 known kinds)

name: check_certificate_name
title: Check certificate name (RFC 6125 host / IP identity, or one name match)

name: check_certificate_purpose
title: Check certificate purpose (extended key usage along the path)

name: inspect_csr
title: Inspect CSR (RFC 2986 report, requested extensions, proof of possession)

name: create_csr
title: Create CSR (PKCS#10 request from a JSON spec, Web Crypto signed)

name: verify_certificate_chain
title: Verify certificate chain (the RFC 5280 §6 verdict, offline revocation)

name: build_certificate_path
title: Build certificate path (discovery to a trust anchor, signatures NOT checked)

name: validate_certificate_path
title: Validate certificate path (RFC 5280 §6.1 on an ordered path, link signatures)

name: inspect_crl
title: Inspect CRL (RFC 5280 §5 report, one entry lookup, signature check)

name: check_crl_revocation
title: Check CRL revocation (one certificate against one CRL, optional delta)

name: create_ocsp_request
title: Create OCSP request (RFC 6960 DER, SHA-1 or SHA-256 CertID, nonce)

name: inspect_ocsp_response
title: Inspect OCSP response (RFC 6960 report, signature check)

name: check_ocsp_status
title: Check OCSP status (one response for one certificate: CertID, responder, freshness, nonce)

name: sign_cms
title: Sign CMS (RFC 5652 SignedData, attached or detached, Web Crypto signed)

name: verify_cms
title: Verify CMS SignedData (the RFC 5652 verdict: signers, chains, time-stamps, revocation)

name: inspect_cms
title: Inspect CMS SignedData (RFC 5652 report, signers, attributes, signature values)

name: amend_cms
title: Amend CMS (add an unsigned attribute or an RFC 3161 counter time-stamp)

name: create_timestamp_request
title: Create time-stamp request (RFC 3161 TimeStampReq over data or a digest)

name: inspect_timestamp
title: Inspect time-stamp (RFC 3161 response, token or TSTInfo)

name: verify_timestamp
title: Verify time-stamp (the RFC 3161 verdict: imprint, TSA signature, chain, revocation)

name: inspect_private_key
title: Inspect private key (PKCS#8 description, optional import proof, no key byte)

name: inspect_pkcs12
title: Inspect PKCS#12 (MAC kind, SafeContents, bags; optional MAC check and opening, no key byte)

name: open_pkcs12
title: Open PKCS#12 (MAC, decryption, non-extractable key import, certificates; optional PEM bundle)

name: describe_engine
title: Describe engine & server capabilities

name: explain_code
title: Explain a code (errors, reasons, diagnostics, wrapper codes)

name: draft_governance_issue
title: Draft a governance-compliant GitHub issue (HITL)
